label: Process and device simulation
subgoals: Separate process simulation of structure from device simulation of transport
Refine the mesh at junctions and the dielectric interface
Discretize with box integration and Scharfetter-Gummel fluxes

label: Solving and calibrating
subgoals: Solve the sparse nonlinear system with Newton iterations
Ramp bias in steps to keep each Newton solve converging
Calibrate physical model parameters against measured curves

label: TCAD in the design flow
subgoals: Place TCAD as a slow accurate engine feeding compact models
Trace a DTCO loop from device options to circuit metrics
Use statistical TCAD samples to inform variability models
